# AniStream

> AniStream helps Indonesian anime fans discover anime series, films, genres, schedules, and episode listings. The site indexes third-party video links and does not host video files.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://anistreaming.com/): Browse recent anime and featured sections.
- [Latest anime](https://anistreaming.com/latest)
- [Popular anime](https://anistreaming.com/popular)
- [Genres](https://anistreaming.com/genres)
- [Schedule](https://anistreaming.com/schedule)
- [FAQ](https://anistreaming.com/faq)
- [About AniStream](https://anistreaming.com/about)
- [Contact](https://anistreaming.com/contact): contact@anistreaming.com
- [Terms of Service](https://anistreaming.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://anistreaming.com/privacy)
- [DMCA / Copyright](https://anistreaming.com/dmca)

## Content notes
- Anime details and episode links may be sourced from third parties.
- AniStream does not host video files.
- Contact: [contact@anistreaming.com](mailto:contact@anistreaming.com)
